Gurpreet Fernandes
Backend Engineer | Remote
gurpreet.fernandes959@example.com | +91 9478072230

Backend-focused engineer with experience building scalable APIs and background task systems for e-commerce and education platforms. Strong track record delivering measurable performance and reliability improvements through monitoring, automation and optimised data models. Seeking to continue improving backend throughput and operational visibility in a distributed environment. Notice period: 30 days.

Experience
CartNest — Mar 2026 - Present
Backend Engineer (Remote)
- Implemented a Django-based order-processing service with Celery workers and Docker deployment, reducing average order handling latency by 45% and increasing throughput to 1,200 orders/hour.
- Built Python services that integrate with SQS for asynchronous order events and used Redis as a cache layer to reduce database reads by 60%, improving response p95 from 420ms to 180ms.
- Containerised services with Docker and deployed to EC2, instrumented with CloudWatch dashboards and alerts which cut incident MTTD by 70%.
- Maintained Confluence runbooks and Git-based CI workflows; used Jira for sprint planning and reduced regression incidents through automated tests and release gating.

Kite Learning — Jun 2021 - Feb 2026
Python Developer (Remote)
- Developed FastAPI microservices for content delivery and user progress tracking backed by postgresql, increasing API availability to 99.95% and supporting a 3x user growth.
- Introduced Redis caching and background Celery tasks to handle report generation, reducing synchronous request times by 80% and lowering DB load during peak hours.
- Dockerised the application stack and managed deployments on EC2; implemented CloudWatch metrics and SQS-based job queues to stabilize peak traffic bursts.
- Documented architecture and runbooks in Confluence, used Git for code reviews and Jira for cross-team issue tracking to accelerate delivery cadence.

Projects
- Course Progress Aggregator: Python service that aggregates student progress across modules, uses Redis for intermediate caching and writes summary metrics to postgresql; reduced report generation time from minutes to seconds.
- Local Dev Docker Compose: Multi-service Docker setup mimicking production queues (SQS stub) and Celery workers to speed onboarding; included Confluence-guided setup instructions.

Skills
Languages: Python
Frameworks & Tools: Django, FastAPI, Celery, Docker
Datastores & Infra: postgresql, Redis, SQS, EC2, CloudWatch
Collaboration & Workflow: Git, Jira, Confluence

Education
MCA, Symbiosis
